title: Remote Control Project Kickoff
summary: The team met for their first project meeting to discuss the design and development of a new remote control. They covered tool training, project plans, conceptual design, and remote control features. The group also brainstormed design ideas by drawing animals on the whiteboard. Finally, they planned next steps and upcoming meetings.
topics: Remote control features and target market
decisions: The remote control will feature a user-friendly design targeted at a wide market.
The team will develop a remote control with basic functions, volume, channel control, and a menu display.
